summary: The proposal has a coherent problem context, four objectives, two referenced diagrams, a detailed schedule, and a specific AI-tools table. However, it needs substantial revision: the required Abstract is absent; the Problem section proposes the solution; one objective uses two verbs and one objective subsection does not meet the two-paragraph requirement; a documentation page is incorrectly included in the bibliography; the AI statement lacks the required confirmation that generated text was checked; the schedule includes thesis writing and presentation preparation; and at least one citation, a contraction, and the Figure 2 caption violate the stated rules.

findings.title: Required Abstract Is Missing
findings.description: Add the required Abstract section before the Introduction, with a proposal summary of approximately one-third to one-half page.

findings.title: Introduction Lacks Text Before Its First Subsection
findings.description: Add a short introductory paragraph under Section 1 before subsection 1.1, explaining what the introduction covers; the section currently jumps directly from the chapter heading to a subsection.

findings.title: Problem Section Proposes a Solution
findings.description: Keep the Problem section limited to the problem and its consequences. Move the proposed platform and expiry-based solution to Motivation or Objective, or rewrite this sentence as a consequence without proposing a system.

locations.quote: A self-service platform that arms the workfow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation.

findings.title: Objective Uses Two Verbs
findings.description: Rewrite the objective with one action verb, for example by choosing either designing or implementing, and apply the same correction to the corresponding subsection heading and objective bullet.

locations.quote: •   Design   and   implement      connectors     with   expiry

findings.title: Citation Follows the Full Stop
findings.description: Move the citation before the sentence-ending full stop so the citation is integrated into the sentence, e.g. “temporal model [BBF01].”

locations.quote: temporal    model.    [BBF01]     Joshi  et  al. generalise   this  idea  to  role  assignments

findings.title: Documentation Is Listed as a Bibliography Entry
findings.description: Remove the Keycloak administration guide from the bibliography and retain it as a footnote or other non-bibliography web reference, because the bibliography should contain peer-reviewed publications only.

locations.quote: [Key26]       Keycloak     Authors,    “Keycloak     Server    Administration      Guide. ”   Accessed:

findings.title: AI Statement Lacks Review Confirmation
findings.description: Add an explicit first-person confirmation that you carefully checked all AI-generated text for correctness and coherence, as required by the transparency statement.

locations.section: Transparency in the Use of AI Tools
locations.quote: I used  the   following   generative    artifcial   intelligence    (AI)  tool  while   preparing    this proposal.

findings.title: Schedule Includes Thesis Writing and Presentation Tasks
findings.description: Remove thesis writing and final-presentation preparation from the development schedule. Replace this iteration with research or implementation work tied to the objectives, and schedule thesis writing separately if needed outside the agile development plan.

locations.quote: •   Iteration     7 (18–31      March):      Write   the   thesis  and   prepare    the  fnal   presen­ tation.

findings.title: Objective Subsection Has Only One Paragraph
findings.description: Split subsection 4.1 into at least two paragraphs, while retaining the detailed content. It currently presents the subsection as one continuous paragraph, unlike the required two-paragraph minimum for every objective subsection.

locations.section: Objective — Structure Resources as an Inheriting Tree
locations.quote: Maintainership,      audit  policy,  and   grants  pass  down    from   a  folder  to  every  resource beneath    it. One   approval    on  a project   folder   therefore   covers   its Slack  channel    and                                                                                    its   GitHub     team,    and   it covers   a  resource    that  a  maintainer     adds   to  the   folder   next   month    without    a   second   decision.

findings.title: Contraction Used in Formal Prose
findings.description: Replace the contraction with its expanded form (“does not”). Apply the same check throughout the proposal because contractions are disallowed by the writing rules.

findings.title: Figure 2 Caption Is Not Informative Enough
findings.description: Expand the Figure 2 caption to explain the components, trust boundaries, and data/control flows shown, rather than providing only a generic label.

locations.section: Objective — Design and Implement Connectors with Expiry
